in_arabic.name: أبيه
in_arabic.long_meaning: أب (Ab) meaning father and يه (Yah) meaning many or numerous. So, أبيه (Abyah) would mean 'the father of many' or 'the father of all'.

in_urdu.name: Abyah
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Father of Creatures
in_urdu.long_meaning: Abyah ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Derived from the Arabic root 'ab' which means 'father', and 'ya' which means 'creatures'. Abyah is a name that signifies the one who is the father of all creatures. This name holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture, reminding us of Allah's infinite mercy and compassion as the Creator of all things.
